failed: Could not complete this request. Check your connection and shared-trip setup, then retry.
sharedNote: Trip changes are saved to Supabase and shared with members in real time.
conflict: This trip has a newer version. Your input is kept. Review the latest itinerary, then save again.
forbidden: You no longer have permission to perform this action.
inviteExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask the creator for a new code.
inviteUsed: This invitation has already been used, or you already belong to this trip.
inviteHint: Single use · expires after 72 hours. Share privately.
readOnly: Only the creator can edit this itinerary.
emptyChat: Start the conversation with your group.
sendFailed: Not sent. Retry uses the same message ID.
placesUnavailable: Place search unavailable. You can enter a location manually; no coordinates will be invented.
mapUnavailable: Google Map unavailable. Your itinerary remains usable below.
missingCoordinates: No saved coordinates for this day. Select a Google Place when adding an activity.
partialCoordinates: Some activities have no coordinates and are not shown on the map.
routeEstimate: Current estimates from Google, not a schedule for the trip date.
reviewedVersion: I reviewed version {version} · keep my edits
historyDemo: Version history is available for shared trips. Demo changes stay in this tab.
noChanges: Nothing changed. No new version was created.
noProposalsBody: Create the first proposal for this trip. Members vote before anything changes.
invalidProposal: Complete the title, reason, activity and cost first.
proposalHint: Created against the current trip version. Members vote; the creator applies it after a majority approves.
proposalRuleNote: A proposal needs more than half of the members to approve before the creator can apply it. AI proposes — humans decide.
proposalStale: This proposal was created for an older trip version. Create a new proposal against the latest version.
